blocks.text: Architecting a High-Performance IaaS Platform for a Global IT Services Leader
IT-Enabled Services
Client
A global IT services and solution provider with a Fortune 500 client base and a culture focused on execution excellence.
Ambition
To ensure their portfolio of critical Line-of-Business (LOB) applications could be delivered with high performance and high availability to thousands of users across the globe.
Outcome

Architected and migrated their LOB applications from a costly, underperforming on-premise environment to a scalable and resilient public cloud IaaS platform, improving performance and optimizing costs.
The Ambition
A global IT services and solution provider with a Fortune 500 client base and a culture focused on execution excellence.
The Challenge

Their on-premise hosted applications were slow, unresponsive, and delivered inconsistent performance for their global users. The significant investment in redundant on-premise infrastructure to ensure high availability was complex and extremely expensive. Troubleshooting performance issues was draining a significant amount of time and energy from their IT team.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to deliver services at peak productivity and efficiency to their global clients. This required their internal LOB applications to be always-on and high-performing, regardless of where their employees were accessing them from.
Ambition, Realized

The benefits were tangible and visible from day one. Application performance improved dramatically and was consistent for all users, regardless of region. The architecture was scalable on demand, allowing them to optimize costs without compromising performance. The inherent HA and DR capabilities of the public cloud provided peace of mind and eliminated the need for complex, expensive on-premise setups. The secure, locked-down deployment ensured their data was always protected.
Key Business Impact
Dramatically Improved Global Application Performance
Achieved High Availability & Resilience for LOB Apps
Optimized TCO Compared to On-Premise Infrastructure
Enhanced Data Security & Availability in the Cloud
